// diagnostic

E0739

{operation} of a `{tag}` value could stop the program.

What

{operation} of a `{tag}` value could stop the program.

Why

`{tag}` is `timing: .Fixed`, and checked arithmetic stops when its result does not fit, so whether the program stops would depend on the value.

Fix

Use `wrapping_add`, `wrapping_sub`, `wrapping_mul` or `wrapping(...)`, or mask the value into range first.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0739: tests/ui/taint/fixed_timing_checked_arithmetic_is_e0739.stderr.

Error [jet.FixedTimingCheckedArithmetic]: Checked `+`, `-` or `*` of a `Key` value could stop the program
  --> tests/ui/taint/fixed_timing_checked_arithmetic_is_e0739.jet:4:8
    |
  4 |     a: k + m
    |        ^^^^^
 Why: `Key` is `timing: .Fixed`, and checked arithmetic stops when its result does not fit, so whether the program stops would depend on the value
 Fix: Write it inside `wrapping(...)` or `#Arithmetic(.Wrapping)`, or mask the value into range first
